name: retro
label: Retro
css: .style-retro { background-color: var(--slide-surface, #FFFFFF); width: 1080px; height: 1080px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; padding: 32px; position: relative; font-family: 'Macondo', serif; overflow: hidden; border: 3px solid var(--slide-text, #111827); box-shadow: 8px 8px 0px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1); } .style-retro::before { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0; background: repeating-linear-gradient(0deg, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.02) 0px, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.02) 2px, transparent 2px, transparent 4px); pointer-events: none; } .style-retro .hook { font-size: 80px; font-weight: 900; color: var(--slide-text, #111827); line-height: 1.1; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: -2px; margin: 0; z-index: 1; max-width: 85%; } .style-retro .text { font-size: 50px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--slide-text, #111827); line-height: 1.2; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.5px; margin: 0; z-index: 1; max-width: 90%; } .style-retro .step { position: absolute; top: 32px; right: 32px; font-size: 160px; font-weight: 900; color: var(--slide-text, #111827); opacity: 0.08; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; line-height: 1; z-index: 0; } .style-retro .brand { position: absolute; bottom: 32px; left: 32px; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--slide-text, #111827); text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 2px; z-index: 1; } .slide-code.style-retro { background-color: #1a1a1a; border-color: var(--slide-primary, #3B82F6); color: #FFFFFF; } .slide-code.style-retro .hook { color: var(--slide-primary, #3B82F6); text-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.5); } .slide-code.style-retro .text { color: #E5E7EB; } .slide-code.style-retro .step { color: var(--slide-primary, #3B82F6); opacity: 0.15; } .slide-code.style-retro .brand { color: var(--slide-primary, #3B82F6); } .slide-insight.style-retro { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #1a1a1a 0%, #2d2d2d 100%); border-color: var(--slide-primary, #3B82F6); } .slide-insight.style-retro .hook { color: var(--slide-primary, #3B82F6); text-shadow: 0 0 15px rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.6); } .slide-insight.style-retro .text { color: #F3F4F6; } .slide-insight.style-retro .insight-text { font-size: 48px; font-weight: 600; color: #FFFFFF; line-height: 1.3; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 1px; z-index: 1; max-width: 90%; margin: 0; } .slide-insight.style-retro .step { color: var(--slide-primary, #3B82F6); opacity: 0.12; } .slide-insight.style-retro .brand { color: var(--slide-primary, #3B82F6); }
